card.name: Verbs after "may" in warnings
card.fires_on: The verb right after "may" (such as occur or develop) in warnings about effects that build up with long-term or repeated use, especially steroid-related adrenal suppression.

modes.label: May occur / develop
modes.description: The verb after "may" in a warning about an effect building up during treatment.
modes.example: This may<< occur>> during treatment or upon withdrawal of treatment.

modes.label: Cumulative effects
modes.description: The verb after "may" following the word cumulative in renal-disease cautions.
modes.example: Cumulative effects of the drug may<< develop>> in patients with impaired renal

modes.description: Words describing changes seen with long-term use, such as bone density loss or growth slowing.
